pnotes.name: Project notes
pnotes.cmd.generate: Generate a CLAUDE.md with an agent
pnotes.noRepo: Add a repository to the workspace to see its project notes.
pnotes.generate: Generate a starter with an agent
pnotes.noDialog: The New Run dialog could not be opened.
pnotes.lead: CLAUDE.md holds the rules of a repository for coding agents: how to run it, what to avoid, which conventions to follow. Every Claude run started in IntelyIDE is told these files.
pnotes.missing: This repository has no CLAUDE.md yet. Create one here, or let an agent write a first version from what it finds in the repository.
pnotes.link: CLAUDE.md is a symbolic link here. It is not edited from this panel; open the file it points to instead.
pnotes.unreadable: The file could not be read as text.
pnotes.meterAria: Size of CLAUDE.md against the limit per file
pnotes.level.large: Large: it is sent with every run
pnotes.level.over: Over the limit: the end is cut off
pnotes.stale: CLAUDE.md changed on disk since it was opened. Refresh and make your change again.
pnotes.toldTitle: What a run here is told
pnotes.toldLead: These are the files a Claude run started now in this repository gets, in this order and with the same limits: your own global CLAUDE.md (if it is switched on in Settings > Roles), then CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.local.md of the repository.
pnotes.toldFoot: A run on several repositories gets the files of each, the first repository first, until 96 KB is reached. Lines that start with @ (imports) are not followed. A run on a server reads the files there.
pnotes.totalAria: Size of all files against the total limit
pnotes.total: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}, {size} of {max}
pnotes.warn.overFile: A file is {size}; only the first {max} of it is sent.
pnotes.warn.overTotal: The files together reach the 96 KB limit; the rest is cut off.
pnotes.warn.leftOut: {count, plural, one {# file gets} other {# files get}} no room at all because of the 96 KB limit.
pnotes.warn.imports: @ imports are not followed: their content does not reach the run. Copy what matters into the file itself.
pnotes.warn.secret: This file looks like it contains a secret (a token, a password or a key). It is sent with every run; take it out.
pnotes.section.name: Project notes
pnotes.section.title: Project notes
pnotes.section.desc: View and edit the CLAUDE.md of each repository and see exactly which CLAUDE.md files a run is told.
pnotes.section.enableDesc: Adds the panel and its commands. Runs get the CLAUDE.md files whether it is on or off.
pnotes.unsaved: CLAUDE.md has changes that are not saved.
pnotes.readOnly.mixed: This file mixes Windows and Unix line endings, which a text box cannot keep. Edit it in the editor.
pnotes.readOnly.encoding: This file is not saved as UTF-8, and runs read CLAUDE.md as UTF-8, so its text reaches them garbled. Open it in the editor and save it as UTF-8.
pnotes.habitsOn: Switched on: a Claude run started now gets this text after the CLAUDE.md files.
